propositions: Blocking LINK edges written before comparability became structural remain unresolved on read, distorting ready/next-batch and parent-first cascade semantics, with 18 such edges found in the repository tracker

A store-wide scan must classify bad edges into three kinds (ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, unreadable) using the current resolver and offer repair that writes replacement links before removing stale ones

Repair must decline pairs whose unlink would cancel a different relation (ambiguous-pair), never repair unreadable edges, refuse execution while a reconciler pass is in flight, and omit store-wide locks to avoid self-deadlock on the non-reentrant write lock

After repair 12 edges were remediated and 8 residual mis-escalated edges remained with closed blocked-sides, making them scheduling-inert but unrepairable because add_dependency forbids links whose source is closed
